key_learnings: 1. NEW ACCOUNT — no performance data yet. Starting in full explore mode.
2. Ported from DreamtimeLullabies: habit_list as default format, 5-slide default, specificity-weighted hooks.
3. Hypothesis: scripture/devotional carousels will drive saves (faith niche is a known save-machine).
4. Hypothesis: gifting/occasion content will drive shares and comments (emotional, tag-a-friend dynamic).
5. 80/20 rule: 80% faith value content, 20% product-adjacent. Faith community is sensitive to inauthenticity.
